name: carousel-17
description: Free-scrolling carousel with a Progress bar bound to Embla's scroll progress.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, type CarouselApi, } from "@workspace/ui/components/carousel" import { Progress } from "@workspace/ui/components/progress" const swatches = [ "Slate", "Stone", "Sand", "Sage", "Moss", "Ocean", "Dusk", "Plum", "Clay", "Rust", ] export default function ScrollProgressCarousel() { const [progress, setProgress] = React.useState(0) const handleApi = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => { if (!api) return const update = () => setProgress(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, api.scrollProgress())) * 100) api.on("scroll", update).on("reInit", update) }, []) return (
{swatches.map((swatch, index) => (
{swatch}
))}
) }
